meetings.route: Exempt: speakers at BVI-hosted business events (7 days)
meetings.detail: Under the 2024 Labour Code exemption order, speakers, presenters and support staff at business events, seminars or conferences hosted by BVI entities need no work permit for up to 7 days (extendable). The host notifies the Chief Immigration Officer at least 48 hours before arrival.

visa-preparation.entry_summary: No visa for Australians; every traveller must complete the free online ED card within 72 hours before travel. Visitors are normally admitted for one month with a return ticket, accommodation and funds.

steps.step: Complete the ED card at bviedcard.gov.vg within 72 hours of travel and keep the confirmation.

culture-cycles.public_holidays: Virgin Islands (British) public holidays still to come in 2026: Monday 23 November (Commemoration of the Great March of 1949 and the Restoration of the Legislative Council); Friday 25 December (Christmas Day); Monday 28 December (Boxing Day). 2027 list noted by Cabinet, with the final list to follow the Governor's proclamation: 1 January; Monday 8 March (Hamilton Lavity Stoutt birth anniversary); 26 March (Good Friday); 29 March (Easter Monday); Monday 17 May (Whit Monday); Friday 11 June (Sovereign's Birthday, to be confirmed); Monday 5 July (Virgin Islands Day); Monday 2, Tuesday 3 and Wednesday 4 August (Emancipation); Monday 18 October (Heroes and Foreparents Day); Monday 22 November (Great March and Restoration of the Legislative Council); Monday 27 and Tuesday 28 December (Christmas and Boxing Day, in lieu).
